```{r}

library(gm)
```

# Overview 

I saw the [`gm` package](https://flujoo.github.io/gm/index.html) on this [Bluesky post](https://bsky.app/profile/andrew.heiss.phd/post/3m2cmi4cuok27) and thought I'd give it a try. Here's the [reference document](https://flujoo.github.io/gm/articles/gm.html). 

---

Create simple music: 

```{r}
music <- 
  Music() +
  Meter(4, 4) +
  Line(c("C5", "D5", "E5", "F5"))
  
show(music)
```

Let's try something a bit more complicated: 

```{r}
moon <- Music() + 
  Meter(4, 4) + 
  Key(2) + 
  Line(
    pitches = c("A3", "B3", "D4", "E4", "F#4", "A4", "B4"),
    durations = c("quarter.", "eighth", "eighth", "eighth", "eighth", "eighth", "whole")
  )

show(moon)
```

Note that the above is the opening ascent of 「彩云追月」 ("Colorful Clouds Chasing the Moon")^[Taken from [Pentatonic _Xuangong_ 旋宮 Transformations in Chinese Music](https://mtosmt.org/issues/mto.24.30.1/mto.24.30.1.lam.html) by Nathan L. Lam].
